description: NEGATIVE CAPABILITY — pins what the cross-field check CANNOT do. The model reads quantity 1 where the source says 2, and unit_price 45.00, and total 45.00. Every value is wrong-or-right individually plausible, and the arithmetic AGREES: 1 x 45.00 == 45.00. The check passes and a wrong total lands ok. This fixture exists so that blind spot stays documented and cannot be quietly overclaimed as caught.
instruction:
The source document is one invoice line.

Read:

quantity: the number of units.

unit_price: the price per unit in USD, as a number.

total_usd: the line total in USD, as a number.

Cite the verbatim span you read each value from.
